scope: Independent design review of the exact fixed N06 source22 producer plan; not implementation/source/consumer/runtime/admission/native/full-BIZQ acceptance.

preparedProof.status: Packet-local prepared evidence; not canonical or activated.

minimumImplementationConditions: Use a literal proof22 descriptor/private validator bound to exact proof bytes, ten source metadata rows, ordered 180 same-ID records, accepted IDs, and zero replacements.

Validate proof structure/order/hash, current catalog and QSet, exact raw source bytes and taxonomy, canonical objects, accepted option binding, historical before objects, and before source/QSet hashes.
Reconstruct v21 privately from the fixed before objects and route it through the unchanged v21 verifier and predecessor chain.
Leave all prior proof bytes, twelve fixed descriptors, four private guards, schemas, selectors, and public authority unchanged.
Add a v21 fixture-restoration step and route every historical fixture that may start at v22 through exact v22→v21→earlier restoration, preserving each test's old version/target assertions.
Register the new v22 test path in the explicit canonical test list without replacing existing tests.

Advance only the existing N05 consumer test current-runtime contentVersion assertion to exact v22; preserve its v21 map/proof and all 153 N05 object assertions, while the separate new22 consumer test binds the whole current v22 QSet.

risks.finding: Fixture restoration must explicitly recognize v22 at each descending historical path; missing one entry could make historical tests fail before their intended assertion.
risks.mitigation: Use the bounded restoreOodSource21Fixture helper, update only the existing chain branches, and preserve version/hash assertions.

risks.finding: The existing N05 consumer test currently checks the current loaded runtime against historical v21; after app sync that one current-runtime assertion must move to exact v22, while its historical map/proof checks remain v21.
risks.mitigation: Update only that assertion; preserve all historical N05 ID/object checks and bind current v22 in the new22 consumer test.

rejectedAlternatives: Public arbitrary proof/map override or waiver
Duplicating all full question objects in the verifier descriptor
Changing schemas/selectors/runtime rules or historical proof contents
Retargeting historical tests to v22 or weakening earlier assertions
New admission authority, alternate pipeline, or unrelated fixture refactor

decisionBoundary.clarification: The design PASS permits the specified root-owned source/proof writes needed for verification. Passing the design review does not itself accept those writes or the resulting producer package; established implementation, preservation, migration, producer QA and downstream acceptance remain applicable.
